cands.name: Mike Redondo
cands.bio: Republican attorney. Began at Holland & Knight; founded Redondo Law PA in 2019. Florida House District 118 since December 2023 special election; re-elected 2024 with 68.3%.
cands.local_ties: Born in Miami (1984); lives in Miami. University of Florida and Florida State law graduate (Wikipedia).

record.text: On June 30, 2025, all 22 members of the House GOP freshman class pledged support for him to serve as Speaker after the 2030 elections (a vote of support, not an office held).

cands.gaps: Committees, donors, endorsements, controversies not searched beyond Wikipedia. Owner-source search NOT run (shared web-search budget exhausted).

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
